_what: Strategy conveyor ('esteira') for WIN/WDO: agents (or the assistant) write FAMILIES of simple rules, b3/esteira.py screens every variant on EXPLORATION with one fixed default exit, and the survivors go to the Clear demo, which is the real test. Owner 2026-11-17: 'a estrategia nao e validada no backtest... precisa ver um jeito de achar regras boas que nao sejam tao ruins, e tambem nao sejam tao ajustadas... precisa ser uma esteira'. Proposal accepted the same day with 'tudo aprovado' (screen criteria below, automatic demo entry and cut, the 15-rule stop replaced by a daily limit).
_split: Exploration only (splits_b3.json). Validation stays unread: it is used once per candidate, only before a REAL-account decision by the owner. The final test stays locked.

family_limits._why: simple rules with a small grid; the grid exists only to check the plateau, not to optimise

default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

costs: pattern_search_b3.json cost_reevaluation (WIN) / wdo_extension.costs (WDO): 'measured' decides, 'measured_p90' is reported only

screen._plateau: neighbours = the variants one grid step away on ONE parameter (same timeframe); at least two thirds of them must have mean net > 0 at the measured cost, and there must be at least one neighbour
screen._best: per family and market, only the passing variant with the highest mean net per trade goes on
screen._overlap: share of the candidate's trades whose entry has the SAME side within 5 minutes of a trade of an already selected (or deployed) conveyor rule; above 0.5 it is the same bet and is dropped
screen._not_used: deflated Sharpe and PBO are reported (honesty) but do not decide demo entry; they remain the bar for any real-account decision

checks._checks: before any result: (1) the signal on the history cut at 3 points equals the full-history signal up to each cut (no look-ahead); (2) the signal of a session computed from only that session plus the 20 before equals the full-history one (the live robot can rebuild it). A family failing either is rejected without reading a result.

once_only: a family id is screened once; a changed family must take a new id (its variants count again). research/b3/esteira/ledger.jsonl holds every variant read.

demo._demo: a survivor enters the Clear demo by itself (own magic, 1 contract, the default exit on the server); after 60 demo trades it is switched off if its mean net per trade is negative; at 200 trades it becomes a candidate for an owner decision (validation read once, then the owner decides). Implemented in step 3 of the conveyor; until then survivors are listed for the assistant to deploy.
